learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 41 New York products (category 59) of 115, one page.
notes: A custom 'product' post type, not WooCommerce. Ordinary WP categories hold both blog and product terms; New York is id 59, with Vapes (229) and Pre-Roll (70) under it and a leaf per line: '2G Royal Palm Premium Oil All-in-One', '1.1G Premium Oil All-in-One', '1.1G Premium Oil All-in-One Sweet Edition', '1.5G Diamond Infused Pre-Roll', '3.5G Royal Minis 7x Live Resin Pre-Roll Pack'. California products sit under their own category and are not in this feed.

Titles are '<SIZE> <LINE> - <STRAIN>' in capitals, so title_case is on ('2G PALM - MANGO HAZE', '1.1G Premium Oil All-In-One - CHEMDAWG'); the 2g titles shorten Royal Palm to PALM, so the line comes from the category. The site's spellings are kept ('COOCHIE RUNTS' on the 2g, 'KING LOUIS XII').
Every NY vape is an all-in-one (the category names say so). Royal Minis are 7 x 0.5g, 3.5g in all, as the title says.
No flower in NY on the site (the New York > Flower category is empty), though stores carry Honey King flower.
